judged_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-11 — `execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` throws (IndexError from PG::Result#[] on an out-of-range/empty result set, or NoMethodError on nil) whenever no category name string-matches the `embed_category` site_setting value — the default state for any install that never set `embed_category` to an exact existing category name — aborting the whole migration transaction (including `create_table`) before any table is created, blocking `rake db:migrate` for a large fraction of real installs.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i`. If that SELECT returns 0 rows (e.g., embed_category unset/mismatched), indexing `[0]` on the PG::Result will raise (out-of-range) or return nil leading to an exception before the later `if category_id == 0` fallback can run. That would abort the migration and block `db:migrate` on installs without a matching category name.
